title: GTA6 and Zelda Rumored for a November Showdown
description: Nintendo prepares for The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, sparking speculation about a November launch alongside GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Push Square, Nintendo is hosting a 40th Anniversary Direct for The Legend of Zelda. The broadcast promises to deliver news and updates on the iconic franchise.

Fans and industry watchers are anticipating that the showcase will feature footage of the previously announced Ocarina of Time remake.

## A Potential November Clash with GTA6

Speculation circulating in the gaming community suggests that the Ocarina of Time remake could potentially launch on the successor to the Switch (often referred to as Switch 2) in November. 

Interestingly, this rumored release window places it right alongside Rockstar's highly anticipated blockbuster, GTA6. A simultaneous or closely timed release of these two major titles would set up a monumental clash for consumer attention and holiday sales.

While official confirmation is expected during the upcoming Direct, the possibility of sharing a release window with GTA6 has certainly amplified the excitement surrounding Nintendo's anniversary plans.

## Editor's Take

If the November release window speculation holds true, the holiday season could witness an unprecedented clash between Nintendo's iconic franchise and GTA6. Gamers might have to make some tough choices, though we must wait for official announcements to see how the schedule actually unfolds.
